newsitem.title: UK: Silver fixes above $5.00 first time since Oct 1996.
newsitem.headline: Silver fixes above $5.00 first time since Oct 1996.

text.p: Silver was fixed at 503.00 cents an ounce on Tuesday, its first fixing above the psychological 500 cents level since October 14, 1996.
The white metal, which has soared some 30 cents over the past four days, had been fixed at 494.10 cents on Monday.
Silver fixes above $5.00 first time since Oct 1996
Silver's rally since last Thursday has been attributed largely to U.S. investment funds buying the volatile market. Prices surged above the 500 cents an ounce level in late trading on Monday.
The metal was quiet early on Tuesday, however, as the precious metals market turned its attention to gold.
"Silver's a bit sluggish this morning. It's still bullish and leading the trend, but gold is holding its own right now," a dealer said.
Buoyed by silver's strength, gold prices notched up in Asian and European trading and were holding steady at around $357.00 an ounce.
